title: Bomb attack by the Revolutionary Brigades on the Quartel-Mestre-General building, in Lisbon, Portugal
summary: Wikidata item Q112157664, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "attack perpetrated on March 9, 1973". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
